groups.title: Search field: search glass larger (17→20px) and darker; query text bigger
groups.summary: Inside the search bar the magnifier grows from 17 to 20px and switches from a muted grey to full ink, the query "Dog"/"dog" is 3px taller, and the clear (×) and visual-search icons shift ~20px left as the bar's right edge moves (1018→1045, no longer lining up with the chip row). Together the live search input reads heavier than the design.

groups.title: Filter row: design's All Images / License (3) / Orientation filters replaced by Vectors / Videos / PNGs links
groups.summary: The design's row has a filter button with a "1" badge, "All Images", an orange active "License (3) ×" chip and "Orientation", then a divider and related-search pills (puppy, golden retriever, corgi…). Live has a plain filter button, asset-type links (Vectors, Videos, PNGs) and different related pills (hot dog, happy dog, cute dog…) with visible 1px borders. All chip size/spacing/missing/extra findings in this row come from that different chip set (and the row being 287px lower).

groups.title: Results grid: 3 photos per row (~282px tall) on live vs 4 per row (237–269px) in the design
groups.summary: Design rows hold 4 justified photos 237–269px tall with 20px gutters spanning x 99–1416; live rows hold 3 photos ~282px tall with 16px gutters spanning x 108–1406. The few photo tiles the tool paired (different photos) show this as width/height/edge changes.

groups.title: Sponsored results sit above the filters on live, pushing filters and grid ~287px down
groups.summary: Live puts a two-row "AD · Sponsored results" strip (16 thumbnails + View More) directly under the page title, so the filter/chip row moves from y≈140 to y≈427 and the gap below the top bar grows from 78px to 363px. In the design the sponsored strip sits inside the results grid (after row 2, and again at the end). These spacing findings are the measurable effect of that one placement change.

groups.title: Search-bar type picker: "All Images" with grid icon becomes "Photos" with camera icon
groups.summary: The pill at the left of the search bar reads "All Images" with a 4-square grid icon in the design; live shows "Photos" with a camera icon, so the label is 18px narrower and its chevron sits 15px further left and 2–4px lower.

groups.title: Top-bar right: "Log In" button is "Sign Up" on live; Join Pro 5px narrower
groups.summary: The outline button at the top right says "Log In" in the design and "Sign Up" on live (label 12px wider, button 110→117px); the Join Pro gradient button is 124→119px wide and the Explore chevron sits 3px lower.

groups.title: Live uses neutral greys where the design's ink is blue-tinted (#0e2332 → #171717)
groups.summary: Every text and rail icon colour finding is the same palette shift: the design's navy ink #0e2332 becomes neutral #171717, and its blue-grey secondary greys (#9ca5ab, #a7afb4, #4a5a65) become neutral #6b6b6b/#929292 on the related-search pill icons, the clear × and the carousel arrow.

groups.title: Active rail icon (Search) is orange #fe642c on live vs pink-red #fe496b
groups.summary: The selected Search item in the left rail uses a pinker red in the design and the brand orange on live; the tinted background behind it is the same.

groups.title: Page length 5,067 → 13,010px: rail divider and rail sign-in icon move with it
groups.summary: The full-height rail divider and the content-area panel are just page height, and the rail's bottom sign-in icon follows the page bottom (y 5013 → 12960). Consequence of the larger result set, not a layout difference on its own.

groups.title: Page title: "Dog Photos" → larger "Dog Photos & Images" with different subtitle copy
groups.summary: The design heading "Dog Photos" + "173,834 royalty free vector graphics matching \"Dog\"" is replaced on live by a bigger "Dog Photos & Images" + "4,089 high resolution, royalty free stock photos and pictures matching “Dog”", starting 9px further right and ~5px lower. The tool can't pair them because both size and copy changed.

groups.title: Live shows far more results: different photos and a ~13,000px page (photo fragments)
groups.summary: The design mock has 52 tiles (incl. a repeated set) ending at y≈4,800; live loads many more real results down to y≈11,600. The unmatched design grid and the many shapes/icons/text the tool found inside live photos (light backgrounds, dog features) are just this content difference.

groups.title: Next page, pagination and "How was your search experience?" card: same parts, ~7,000px lower on live
groups.summary: Both pages end with an orange "Next page" button, page numbers and a feedback card with thumbs up/down. They can't be paired only because live's page is much longer. Differences to check by eye: last page "100" vs "41", and the feedback card has a visible border on white on live vs a white card on the grey canvas in the design.

groups.title: Left rail: notifications (bell) icon missing on live
groups.summary: The design's rail has six icons ending with a bell at y≈357; live stops at the downloads icon — no notifications entry (likely logged-out state).

groups.title: Live result tiles carry "Free" / "Sponsored" badges the design doesn't show
groups.summary: Many live photos have a small white "Free" pill top-left, and the final rows of the grid are sponsored photos labelled "Sponsored". The design tiles have no badges. Only a few badges were detected, but each is the same tile-badge pattern.

groups.title: Live inserts "related searches" chip blocks inside the results grid
groups.summary: Twice in the live grid (y≈2289 and y≈8249) a tile slot is replaced by a block of 10 related-search pills (dog breed, dog lover, dog playing…). The design has no such in-grid block; these are all its pills, icons and labels.

groups.title: Live inserts a Vecteezy Pro upsell tile in the grid
groups.summary: A 518×345 orange-to-magenta gradient tile ("Vecteezy Pro · Unlimited access and downloads · Get Started") sits in the live results grid at y≈5990. The design has no promo tile.

groups.title: Live has a full site footer the design doesn't show
groups.summary: Live ends with a dark footer: a "The best value in the industry – Try Pro today." band, four link columns (Products, Content, Learn More, Languages), logo + social icons, copyright and legal links, a Light-mode toggle, and a stray "Current Split Test:" debug line below. The search design mock stops after the feedback card.
